g.text: C Opposite rotations to first order
Rigid motifs and the shared bridge are drawn from stored coordinates. Exterior motifs and sphere surfaces are omitted from panel A, but retained in checks.
81 audited frames; maximum bar |length² − 2| < 2.5×10⁻¹⁵; minimum nonbar length² − 2 > 1.965; maximum motif rotation ≈ 7.11°.

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #7a838b

g.text: Finite range: numerical samples, not a certified continuum. The separate exact implicit-function argument establishes a true local branch near t = 0.
